title: cms.page.published payload
description:
Published by Abeon CMS when a page or post in one language is published, a new version included. Fronts are told through their own revalidation webhook; this event is for platform consumers (search, analytics, a data warehouse) that want to know content went live.

The file name is the routing key.

site_id.description: The CMS site inside the organisation's instance.

page_id.description: The page or post, the same in every language.

translation_id.description: The page in one language: the thing that was published.

type.description: A page in the tree or a post under the posts page.

path.description: The path a reader opens, `/` for the homepage.

revision_id.description: The revision now live; its content is read from the Content API, not carried here.
